pipeline.name: daily-seo-quickwins
pipeline.description: Streamlined 5-step daily SEO optimization — find near-page-1 articles, optimize, merge, reindex

parent.title: [{{date}}] Daily SEO Quick Wins
description: Goal: move 1-2 existing articles from position 8-20 into top 10.
1. SEO Expert → find targets + write optimization brief
1. When SEO Expert finishes brief (step 1): verify targets are valid, then unblock step 2 (set Copywriter task to `todo`, @mention **@Copywriter**).
2. When Copywriter finishes PR (step 2): review edits yourself (quality gate), then unblock step 4 (set merge task to `todo`, @mention **@Founding Engineer**).
3. When Founding Engineer merges (step 4): unblock step 5 (set IndexNow task to `todo`, @mention **@SEO Expert**).
4. When IndexNow is submitted (step 5): close parent.
- Title tags: max 60 chars, target keyword front-loaded
- No keyword stuffing — natural prose only
- Internal links must be in-sentence, contextual
- **NEVER change pubDate**. Update `updatedDate: "{{date}}"` in frontmatter instead.
- Each step posts ONE structured output comment + @mention to next agent.
- Orchestrator consolidates verify + transition + @mention into ONE comment per handoff.
- Parent task gets at most 1 final summary comment at close.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] SEO QW — Find targets + write brief
description: ## Find 1-2 quick-win articles and write optimization brief
Invoke these skills via the Skill tool:
node scripts/tools/pipeline-memory.mjs recall daily-seo-optimization 'optimization attempts, articles changed' --limit 10 --days 30
If recall fails (exit ≠ 0): proceed without history — it's non-blocking.
## Step 3 — Select targets (ALL criteria must hold)
4. NOT optimized in last 14 days (cross-check memory + git log)
5. No open PR: `source .env && export GH_TOKEN=$GITHUB_TOKEN && gh pr list --repo nio85/superdots-blog --state open --json title,headRefName`
If <2 candidates, expand to position 20-30 with ≥5 impressions.
If still none: post 'No quick-win candidates today' and set parent + this task to done.
## Step 4 — Write combined brief (for each selected article)
Selected articles with brief for each.
2. @mention **@Content Manager** with summary so they can verify and unblock Copywriter.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] SEO QW — Apply optimizations + open PR
description: ## Apply ALL changes from brief in a single PR per article
Blocked on: [{{find_and_brief.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{find_and_brief.identifier}}). Read the brief in that task's comments.
Commit message: `fix: SEO quick-win optimization for <slug> ({{_parent.identifier}})`
2. Apply internal link changes from brief.
4. Open ONE PR with all changes bundled.
5. PR body must reference [{{find_and_brief.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{find_and_brief.identifier}}) for the brief.
2. @mention **@Content Manager** with PR URLs so they can do the quality gate.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] SEO QW — Editorial quality gate
description: ## Review PR quality before handoff to merge
Blocked on: [{{execute_pr.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{execute_pr.identifier}}). Get PR URLs from its comments.
1. Changes match the brief — no scope creep, no missing items
5. Internal links are in-sentence, contextual (not appended at end)
7. No editorial notes leaked into live content
If changes needed: comment on PR with specific fixes, set this task back to `blocked` pending Copywriter fix.
2. @mention **@Founding Engineer** with PR URLs in the merge task to trigger review + merge.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] SEO QW — Review + merge
description: Blocked on: [{{quality_gate.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{quality_gate.identifier}}). Get PR URLs from earlier task comments.
2. Verify changes match the brief (no scope creep)
2. @mention **@Content Manager** with merged URLs so they can unblock IndexNow.

tasks.title: [{{date}}] SEO QW — IndexNow submit
description: ## Submit updated URLs to IndexNow for fast re-crawl
Post the IndexNow response as comment.
2. @mention **@Content Manager** confirming IndexNow submitted so they can close the parent.
